description.value:
You keep quiet books on how hard truth will be to install.

You can spend 10 minutes performing a brief analytical rite (charts, string maps, numerology, argument trees) focused on a planned Alignment Shift for a Hex or Spark.

  • At the end of the rite, the GM tells you whether the upcoming Align-Shift DC for this attempt is trending easier than usual, about normal, or harder than usual, based on current fiction, opposition, and setup.
  • This does not give you exact numbers or guarantee success; it provides a forecast so you know whether to bring more OPs, allies, or preparation.

In other words, you glimpse whether the Lens is currently tilted in your favor.

⟁ Per-Use Ability — Prism Ledger
Recovery: 10-min rite  ·  Action: Downtime (10 min)  ·  Use: Click this feature on your sheet to invoke.
Spend 10 minutes on charts/string maps/numerology focused on a planned Alignment Shift. GM tells you whether the upcoming Align-Shift DC is trending easier / normal / harder. Forecast only — no exact numbers.
